about.text: I am a full-stack web developer with 10+ years of experience and a strong focus on front-end. I have contributed to building high-traffic platforms, Web3 solutions, and interactive 3D projects, with both small teams and big companies, remote and on-site.
I am excited about contributing to creative passion-driven projects, I enjoy scroll-driven animation and webgl work.

Over the past years I've been moving into gameplay programming using Unreal Engine. I've collaborated on the “Ocean Threshold” immersive experience and have shipped a “Gnarly Crawl” game as a solo developer.
